Mandalay holds the team together, deals with the press and the police, and spends most of her time with Kota, who has started letting her close. She blames herself for the camp and does not say so; her calm has a harder edge now, and she counts heads even at the dinner table.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf133\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[659,{\"name\":\"After Note: Pixie-Bob\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf134\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kamino_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Pixie-Bob was struck down early in the League's raid on the forest camp and lay unconscious for the rest of the night while the forest burned.
